attributes.name: pill button usage
attributes.definition: Whether and how pill-shaped (fully rounded) buttons or controls appear on the page, and their role.

values.definition: Pill button used as the main action of a section, standing alone or with a heading.
Outlined pill-shaped button used for secondary actions such as 'View all'.
Pill-radius transparent control used as a menu toggle.
Buttons are not pill-shaped or not present.

attributes.name: section button alignment
attributes.definition: How a section's action button is positioned relative to its content.

values.definition: Button centered horizontally beneath the content, such as a card grid or heading.
Button aligned to the side or within the content row.

attributes.name: navigation responsive behavior
attributes.definition: How the main navigation adapts across viewport sizes.

values.value: toggle hidden on desktop, shown on mobile
values.definition: Menu toggle is hidden on desktop and appears only on mobile.
Menu toggle is visible on all viewport sizes.

attributes.name: section content density
attributes.definition: How much content a section holds.

values.definition: Section contains only a heading and one button.
Section holds a grid of cards followed by an action.

codes.value: toggle hidden on desktop, shown on mobile
